landmarks.name: Eiffel Tower
landmarks.model_credit: "Eiffel Tower" by Newcandle (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:912478, via https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:EiffelTower_fixed.stl), CC BY-SA 3.0. Converted to a Tellus mesh and scaled to a 124.9 m base and 330 m height.

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
landmarks.model_credit: "Golden Gate Bridge" SketchUp model from the Google 3D Warehouse (Golden_Gate.skp, contributors Google / Google 3D Warehouse), used under the 3D Warehouse General Model License. Converted with tools/landmark-convert: placed from its own UTM georeference, the Marin side raised where its deck sank below the real road (up to 44.5 m at Vista Point) and its approach viaduct stood on four towers like the real one's, see-through textures cut to their opaque texels, materials mapped to blocks.
